yes, correct!

Is there some specific reason for using struct keyword despite declaring typedef for this structure - https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14433/diffs#3a08d2566372818bf849b51bed343c98e42ff89b_509_508 if not then it can be omitted.

OK, I missed that one.  I did wonder whether it is worth having this struct at all - is it likely to grow?  Also, instance_id is only used by one of the functions that takes it.

I agree but developments keep going on. Additionally instance_id is required by one of the command's dissection as it carries some data in request but not in response so using instance id we are populating the associated response field dissections.
